feed.title: MolQuantDyn@Haverford
feed.subtitle: The Molecular Quantum Dynamics Lab (MolQuantDyn Lab) at Haverford College, Department of Physics and Astronomy focuses on developing and using quantum dynamics methods to study processes relevant to atmopsheric chemistry, astrophysics, combustion and catalysis.

entry.title: Collaborative paper on PH3 collision with H2 has been published in PCCP.

link.title: Collaborative paper on PH3 collision with H2 has been published in PCCP.

entry.content: A collaborative work involving groups in Italy and Tunisia led by Ayda Badri on the state-to-state collisional rates in the scattering of PH3 with H2 using the close-coupling method has been published in Physical Chemistry Chemical Physics.
entry.summary: A collaborative work involving groups in Italy and Tunisia led by Ayda Badri on the state-to-state collisional rates in the scattering of PH3 with H2 using the close-coupling method has been published in Physical Chemistry Chemical Physics.

entry.title: Hervé’s paper on PO+-H2 has been published in JPCA.

link.title: Hervé’s paper on PO+-H2 has been published in JPCA.

entry.content: Our work in collaboration with Francois Lique group on the calculations of the low lying rovibrational states of PO+-H2 using the MCTDH and the close-coupling method has been published in the Journal of Physical Chemistry A. Congratulations to Hervé on the second paper of his PhD thesis!

entry.title: The members of the QDRG gave research talks on their PhD projects at the EAIFR PhD Seminar Series.

link.title: The members of the QDRG gave research talks on their PhD projects at the EAIFR PhD Seminar Series.

entry.content: Sosthene, Hervé and Wala presented their research at the EAIFR PhD Seminar Series. Sosthene’s work is entitled: “Development of a Potential Energy Surface for H2O on TiO2 Surface”. Herve’s work is entitled: “Rovibrational States Calculations of the Rigid Rotors H2O-HCN and H2O-H2O: Representation of the Potential Energy Surface and Some Results”. Wala’s work is entitled: “The magnetism of the hematite surface in O₂ adsorption”.

entry.title: Hervé’s paper on H2O-HCN has been published in PCCP.

link.title: Hervé’s paper on H2O-HCN has been published in PCCP.

entry.content: Our work in collaboration with Richard Dawes group, Yohann Scribano, Fabien Gatti and Marie-Lise Dubernet on the calculations of the low lying rovibrational states of H2O-HCN using the MCTDH method has been published in Physical Chemistry Chemical Physics. Congratulations to Hervé on his first paper and the first paper of his PhD thesis!

entry.title: Sosthene visited the group of Prof Fabien Gatti in Orsay, France.

link.title: Sosthene visited the group of Prof Fabien Gatti in Orsay, France.

entry.content: Sosthene spent a 3 months internship at the Institut de Sciences Moleculaires d’Orsay (ISMO) of the Université Paris-Saclay in the team of Prof Fabien Gatti. At ISMO, Sosthene worked on improving his understanding of the MCTDH and applied it to various molecule-surface processes.

The work again made the front cover of the journal.
